abilityDetails.name: Mitosis
abilityDetails.text: Your space docks cannot produce infantry. At the start of the status phase, place 1 infantry from your reinforcements on any planet you control.

abilityDetails.name: Quantum Entaglement
abilityDetails.text: You treat all systems that contain either an alpha or beta wormhole as adjacent to each other. Game effects cannot prevent you from using this ability.

abilityDetails.name: Slipstream
abilityDetails.text: During your tactical actions, apply +1 to the move value of each of your ships that starts its movement in your home system or in a system that contains either an alpha or beta wormhole.

abilityDetails.name: Creuss Gate
abilityDetails.text: When you create the game board, place the Creuss Gate (tile 17) where your home system would normally be placed. The Creuss Gate system is not a home system. Then, place your home system (tile 51) in your play area.

abilityDetails.name: Masters of Trade
abilityDetails.text: You do not have to spend a command token to resolve the secondary ability of the "Trade" strategy card.

abilityDetails.name: Guild Ships
abilityDetails.text: You can negotiate transactions with players who are not your neighbor.

abilityDetails.name: Arbiters
abilityDetails.text: When you are negotiating a transaction, action cards can be exchanged as part of that transaction.

abilityDetails.name: Fragile
abilityDetails.text: Apply -1 to the result of each of your unit's combat rolls.

abilityDetails.name: Brilliant
abilityDetails.text: When you spend a command token to resolve the secondary ability of the "Technology" strategy card, you may resolve the primary ability instead.

abilityDetails.name: Analytical
abilityDetails.text: When you research a technology that is not a unit upgrade technology, you may ignore 1 prerequisite.

abilityDetails.name: Assimilate
abilityDetails.text: When you gain control of a planet, replace each PDS and space dock that is on that planet with a matching unit from your reinforcements.

abilityDetails.name: Harrow
abilityDetails.text: At the end of each round of ground combat, your ships in the active system may use their Bombardment abilities against your opponent's ground forces on the planet.

abilityDetails.name: Munitions Reserves
abilityDetails.text: At the start of each round of space combat, you may spend 2 trade goods; you may re-roll any number of your dice during that combat round.

abilityDetails.name: Armada
abilityDetails.text: The maximum number of non-fighter ships you can have in each system is equal to 2 more than the number of tokens in your fleet pool.

abilityDetails.name: Ambush
abilityDetails.text: At the start of a space combat, you may roll 1 die for each of up to 2 of your cruisers or destroyers in the system. For each result equal to or greater than that ship's combat value, produce 1 hit; your opponent must assign it to 1 of their ships.

abilityDetails.name: Pillage
abilityDetails.text: After 1 of your neighbors gains trade goods or resolves a transaction, if they have 3 or more trade goods, you may take 1 of their trade goods or commodities.

abilityDetails.name: Star Forge
abilityDetails.text: Action: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to place either 2 fighters or 1 destroyer from your reinforcements in a system that contains 1 or more of your war suns.

abilityDetails.name: Gashlai Physiology
abilityDetails.text: Your ships can move through supernovas.

abilityDetails.name: Telepathic
abilityDetails.text: At the end of the strategy phase, place the Naalu "0" token on your strategy card; you are first in initiative order.

abilityDetails.name: Foresight
abilityDetails.text: After another player moves ships into a system that contains 1 or more of your ships, you may place 1 token from your strategy pool in an adjacent system that does not contain another player's ships; move your ships from the active system into that system.

abilityDetails.name: Galactic Threat
abilityDetails.text: You cannot vote on agendas. Once per agenda phase, after an agenda is revealed, you may predict aloud the outcome of that agenda. If your prediction is correct, gain 1 technology that is owned by a player who voted how you predicted.

abilityDetails.name: Technological Singularity
abilityDetails.text: Once per combat, after 1 of your opponent's units is destroyed, you may gain 1 technology that is owned by that player.

abilityDetails.name: Propagation
abilityDetails.text: You cannot research technology. When you would research a technology, gain 3 command tokens instead.

abilityDetails.name: Unrelenting
abilityDetails.text: Apply +1 to the result of each of your unit's combat rolls.

abilityDetails.name: Scavenge
abilityDetails.text: After you gain control of a planet, gain 1 trade good.

abilityDetails.name: Nomadic
abilityDetails.text: You can score objectives even if you do not control the planets in your home system.

abilityDetails.name: Orbtial Drop
abilityDetails.text: Action: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to place 2 infantry from your reinforcements on 1 planet you control.

abilityDetails.name: Versatile
abilityDetails.text: When you gain command tokens during the status phase, gain 1 additional command token.

abilityDetails.name: Blood Ties
abilityDetails.text: You do not have to spend influence to remove the custodians token from Mecatol Rex.

abilityDetails.name: Reclamation
abilityDetails.text: After you resolve a tactical action during which you gained control of Mecatol Rex, you may place 1 PDS and 1 space dock from your reinforcements on Mecatol Rex.

abilityDetails.name: Peace Accords
abilityDetails.text: After you resolve the primary or secondary ability of the "Diplomacy" strategy card, you may gain control of 1 planet other than Mecatol Rex that does not contain any units and is in a system that is adjacent to a planet you control.

abilityDetails.name: Quash
abilityDetails.text: When an agenda is revealed, you may spend 1 token from your strategy pool to discard that agenda and reveal 1 agenda from the top of the deck. Players vote on this agenda instead.

abilityDetails.name: Indoctrination
abilityDetails.text: At the start of a ground combat, you may spend 2 influence to replace 1 of your opponent's participating infantry with 1 infantry from your reinforcements.

abilityDetails.name: Devotion
abilityDetails.text: After each space battle round, you may destroy 1 of your cruisers or destroyers in the active system to produce 1 hit and assign it to 1 of your opponent's ships in that system.

abilityDetails.name: Stall Tactics
abilityDetails.text: Action: Discard 1 action card from your hand.

abilityDetails.name: Scheming
abilityDetails.text: When you draw 1 or more action cards, draw 1 additional action card. Then, choose and discard 1 action card from your hand.

abilityDetails.name: Crafty
abilityDetails.text: You can have any number of action cards in your hand. Game effects cannot prevent you from using this ability.

abilityDetails.name: Zeal
abilityDetails.text: You always vote first during the agenda phase. When you cast at least 1 vote, cast 1 additional vote for each player in the game including you.

abilityDetails.name: Raid Formation
abilityDetails.text: When your units use Anti-Fighter Barrage: For each hit produced in excess of your opponent's Fighters, choose 1 of your opponent's ships that has Sustain Damage to become damaged.

abilityDetails.name: Devour
abilityDetails.text: Capture your opponent's non-structure units that are destroyed during combat.

abilityDetails.name: Amalgamation
abilityDetails.text: When you produce a unit, you may return 1 captured unit of that type to produce that unit without spending resources.

abilityDetails.name: Riftmeld
abilityDetails.text: When you research a unit upgrade technology, you may return 1 captured unit of that type to ignore all of the technology's prerequisites.

abilityDetails.name: Voidborn
abilityDetails.text: Nebulae do not affect your ships' movement.

abilityDetails.name: Aetherpassage
abilityDetails.text: After a player activates a system, you may allow that player to move their ships through systems that contain your ships.

abilityDetails.name: Dark Whispers
abilityDetails.text: During setup, take the additional Empyrean faction promissory note; you have 2 faction promissory notes.

abilityDetails.name: Edict
abilityDetails.text: When you win a combat, place 1 command token from your opponent's reinforcements in your fleet pool if it does not already contain 1 of that player's tokens; other player's tokens in your fleet pool increase your fleet limit but cannot be redistributed.

abilityDetails.name: Imperia
abilityDetails.text: While another player's command token is in your fleet pool, you can use the ability of that player's commander, if it is unlocked.

abilityDetails.name: Hubris
abilityDetails.text: During setup, purge your "Alliance" promissory note. Other players cannot give you their "Alliance" promissory note.

abilityDetails.name: Distant Suns
abilityDetails.text: When you explore a planet that contains 1 of your mechs, you may draw 1 additional card; choose 1 to resolve and discard the rest.

abilityDetails.name: Fabrication
abilityDetails.text: Action: Either purge 2 of your relic fragments of the same type to gain 1 relic; or purge 1 of your relic fragments to gain 1 command token.

abilityDetails.name: The Company
abilityDetails.text: During setup, take the 2 additional Nomad faction agents and place them next to your faction sheet; you have 3 agents.

abilityDetails.name: Future Sight
abilityDetails.text: During the Agenda phase, after an outcome that you voted for or predicted is resolved, gain 1 trade good.

abilityDetails.name: Terragenesis
abilityDetails.text: After you explore a planet that does not have a sleeper token, you may place or move 1 sleeper token onto that planet.

abilityDetails.name: Awaken
abilityDetails.text: After you activate a system that contains 1 or more of your sleeper tokens, you may replace each of those tokens with 1 PDS from your reinforcements.

abilityDetails.name: Coalesce
abilityDetails.text: If your flagship or your Awaken faction ability places your units into the same space area or onto the same planet as another player's units, your units must participate in combat during "Space Combat" or "Ground Combat" steps.

abilityDetails.name: The Tribunii
abilityDetails.text: During setup, choose an unplayed faction from among the Mentak, the Xxcha and The Argent Flight; take that faction's home system, command tokens and control markers. Additionally, take the Keleres Hero that corresponds to that faction.

abilityDetails.name: Council Patronage
abilityDetails.text: Replenish your commodities at the start of the strategy phase, then gain 1 trade good.

abilityDetails.name: Law's Order
abilityDetails.text: You may spend 1 influence at the start of your turn to treat all laws as blank until the end of your turn.

abilityDetails.name: Galactic Threat
abilityDetails.text: You cannot vote on agendas. Once per agenda phase, after an agenda is revealed, you may predict aloud the outcome of that agenda. If your prediction is correct, gain 1 technology that is owned by a player who voted how you predicted.

abilityDetails.name: Technological Singularity
abilityDetails.text: Once per combat, after 1 of your opponent's units is destroyed, you may gain 1 technology that is owned by that player.

abilityDetails.name: Propagation
abilityDetails.text: You cannot research technology. When you would research a technology, gain 3 command tokens instead.

abilityDetails.name: Quantum Entaglement
abilityDetails.text: You treat all systems that contain either an alpha or beta wormhole as adjacent to each other. Game effects cannot prevent you from using this ability.

abilityDetails.name: Slipstream
abilityDetails.text: During your tactical actions, apply +1 to the move value of each of your ships that starts its movement in your home system or in a system that contains either an alpha or beta wormhole.

abilityDetails.name: Creuss Gate
abilityDetails.text: When you create the game board, place the Creuss Gate (tile 17) where your home system would normally be placed. The Creuss Gate system is not a home system. Then, place your home system (tile 51) in your play area.

name: Last Bastion
startingTechText: Choose 1 Propulsion blue or 1 Cybernetic yellow technology with no prerequisites

abilityDetails.name: Liberate
abilityDetails.text: When you gain control of a planet, ready that planet if it contains a number of infantry equal to or greater than that planet's resource value; otherwise, place 1 infantry on that planet.

abilityDetails.name: Galvanize
abilityDetails.text: When a game effect instructs a player to galvanize a unit, they place a galvanize token beneath it if it does not have one. Galvanized units roll 1 additional die for combat rolls and unit abilities.

abilityDetails.name: Phoenix Standard
abilityDetails.text: At the end of combat, you may galvanize 1 of your units that participated.

abilityDetails.name: Research Team
abilityDetails.text: When ground forces are committed, if your units on that planet are not already coexisting, you may choose for your units to coexist.

abilityDetails.name: Oceanbound
abilityDetails.text: When your units begin coexisting on a planet, gain an ocean card and ready it. Any time you have more oceans cards than there are planets that contain your coexisting units, discard ocean cards until you do not.

name: The Firmament
startingTechText: Choose 1 Biotic green or 1 Cybernetic yellow technology with no prerequisites

abilityDetails.name: Plots Within Plots
abilityDetails.text: You can score secret objectives already scored by other players if you fulfill their requirements; this does not count against your secret objective limit or the number you can score in a round. When you score another player's secret objective, do not gain a victory point; instead, place a facedown plot card into your play area with that player's control token on it.

abilityDetails.name: Puppets of the Blade
abilityDetails.text: If you have at least 1 plot card in your play area, gain the following ability: Action: Purge The Firmament's faction sheet, leaders, planet cards, and promissory note. Then, gain all the faction components for The Obsidian.

abilityDetails.name: Nocturne
abilityDetails.text: This faction cannot be chosen during setup.

abilityDetails.name: The Blade's Orchestra
abilityDetails.text: When this faction comes into play, flip your home system, double-sided faction components, and all of your in-play plot cards. Then, ready Cronos Hollow and Tallin Hollow.

abilityDetails.name: Marionettes
abilityDetails.text: The player or players whose control tokens are on each plot card are the puppeted players for that plot.

name: The Ral Nel Consortium
startingTechText: Choose 1 Warfare red or 1 Biotic green technology with no prerequisites

abilityDetails.name: Survival Instinct
abilityDetails.text: After another player activates a system that contains your ships, you may move up to 2 of your ships into the active system from adjacent systems that do not contain your command tokens.

abilityDetails.name: Miniaturization
abilityDetails.text: Your structures can be transported by any ship; this does not require or count against capacity. While your structures are in the space area, they cannot use their unit abilities. At the end of your tactical actions, you may place your structures that are in space areas onto planets you control in their respective systems.

name: The Crimson Rebellion
startingTechText: Choose 1 Propulsion blue or 1 Warfare red technology with no prerequisites You also start with your breakthrough, Resonance Generator

abilityDetails.name: Sundered
abilityDetails.text: You cannot use wormholes other than epsilon wormholes. Other players' units that move or are placed into your home system are destroyed.

abilityDetails.name: Incursion
abilityDetails.text: When you activate a system that contains a breach, you may flip that breach; systems that contain active breaches are adjacent. At the end of the status phase, any player with ships in a system that contains an active breach may remove that breach.

abilityDetails.name: The Sorrow
abilityDetails.text: When you create the game board, place The Sorrow (tile 94) where your home system would be placed, and place an inactive breach in it. The Sorrow is not a home system. Then, place your home system (tile 118) in your play area.
